hypothesis: If the L20 ordinary-straight mismatch is primarily a common thermal free-strain authority error, independently replayed one-element FRAME sources with identical L19/L20 stiffness will imply one tightly clustered multiplier on the profile expansion coefficient.
predictedSignature: Only ordinary one-analysis-element FRAME sources with no tee modifier, direct CAESAR source actions, identical L19/L20 global stiffness, and governed-size thermal initial loads are admitted.
Each admitted source independently infers m = 1 + replayResidual/thermalInitialLoadIncrement at its dominant axial global-force component.
A true common thermal-strain authority mismatch produces a tight multiplier cluster across unrelated source elements; geometry, hot-modulus, or topology errors do not.
The inferred multiplier is diagnostic only and cannot become a production material constant without independent CAESAR/material authority.
mechanicsDelta: None. The fingerprint consumes I008 replay evidence and the already-assembled L19/L20 element contributions. It does not alter the solver, material table, thermal coefficient, stiffness, or benchmark tolerances.
decisionReason: Locked run 31302998855 produced evidence fnv1a64:65d6508840406adc. Fifty-five qualified ordinary FRAME sources give median multiplier 1.0454694197686063 with median absolute deviation 1.3166771379857778e-6; gravity-weighted median is 1.0454691805152607. Applied diagnostically to the current 11.7e-6/K profile value this implies about 12.23199e-6/K.
